words.root_logic: re-（回）+ ceive（接住）→ 把递来的接到手里
words.origin: 古法语 receivre，来自拉丁语 recipere（收取）← re＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to be given or sent something; to take delivery of
words.core_concept: closing the hand on what has been sent one's way – 把送到跟前的东西接进手里
words.core_image: 门口递进来一个包裹，他伸手接过，签了字
examples: She received a letter this morning.
The hotel receives guests all year.
semantic_expansions: 收到/接受：把送来的接进手里
接待：把来客接进门
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ ceive（接住）→ 把递来的接到手里

words.root_logic: de-（脱开正道）+ ceive（接住）→ 让人接住的是假的 → 欺骗
words.origin: 古法语 deceivre，来自拉丁语 decipere（诱骗）← de＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
words.core_concept: handing over something false for the other to take as real – 递过去一件假的，让对方当真接下
words.core_image: 他把掺了水的那壶递过去，对方没尝出来
examples: He deceived his own family for years.
Do not let appearances deceive you.
semantic_expansions: 欺骗/蒙骗：递过去假的让人当真接下
误导：使人接住的判断偏了道
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开正道）+ ceive（接住）→ 让人接下假的

words.root_logic: con-（收进）+ ceive（接住）→ 接进来在里头成形 → 构想；亦指怀胎
words.origin: 古法语 conceivre，来自拉丁语 concipere（收纳、孕育）← con＋capere
words.native_definition: to form an idea in the mind; to become pregnant
words.core_concept: taking a thing in and letting it take shape inside – 接进来，让它在里头长成形
words.core_image: 那个念头一进脑子就慢慢长出了轮廓
examples: She conceived the plan on the train.
They could not conceive a child.
semantic_expansions: 构想/设想：接进来在心里长成形
怀孕：同一个「接进来使成形」用在孕育上
words.recall_hint: con-（收进）+ ceive（接住）→ 接进来在里头成形

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ ceive（接住）→ 把外来讯息完整接住 → 察觉
words.origin: 古法语 perceivre，来自拉丁语 percipere（察知）← per＋capere
words.native_definition: to become aware of something through the senses; to regard in a certain way
words.core_concept: catching what comes in fully enough to know it – 把送进来的接得够全，于是知道了
words.core_image: 风里那点异味被他一下接住，立刻回头看
examples: She perceived a change in his tone.
He is perceived as a fair judge.
semantic_expansions: 察觉/感知：把外来讯息接得够全而知晓
看待：接住之后认定成某个样子
words.recall_hint: per-（彻底）+ ceive（接住）→ 把讯息接得够全

words.root_logic: capt（抓取）+ -ure → 一把抓到手里 → 捕获；引申为把景象留住
words.origin: 法语 capture，来自拉丁语 captura（捕获）← capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to catch a person or animal; to record or preserve something
words.core_concept: closing the hand on what was loose – 把在外头的一把抓进手里
words.core_image: 网一收，方才还在跳的那条被兜住了
examples: The escaped animal was captured at dawn.
The photo captured her expression.
semantic_expansions: 捕获/夺取：一把抓到手里
捕捉：把稍纵即逝的景象留住
words.recall_hint: capt（抓取）+ -ure → 一把抓到手里

words.root_logic: capt（抓取）+ -ive → 已被抓住、脱不了身的那个
words.origin: 拉丁语 captivus（被俘的），来自 captus（capere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: a person kept as a prisoner; held and unable to leave
words.core_concept: the one already in the closed hand – 已经落在合起来那只手里的人
words.core_image: 绳子系在木桩上，那人整夜没能挪出那个圈
examples: The captives were released at last.
He was held captive for a month.
semantic_expansions: 俘虏/被囚者：已被抓住、脱不了身的那个
words.recall_hint: capt（抓取）+ -ive → 已被抓住脱不了身的

words.root_logic: parti（份）+ cip（取）+ -ate → 领走自己那一份 → 加入其中
words.origin: 拉丁语 participare（分享、参与），来自 pars（份）＋capere（取）
words.native_definition: to take part in an activity or event
words.core_concept: taking up one's own share of a joint doing – 在共做的事里领走属于自己那一份
words.core_image: 几个人各领一段绳，一头一个攥着往上拉
examples: She participates in every rehearsal.
Only members may participate.
semantic_expansions: 参加/参与：在共做之事里领走自己那一份
words.recall_hint: parti（份）+ cip（取）→ 领走自己那一份

words.root_logic: participate（领份加入）+ -ant（人）→ 领了一份、在其中的那个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 participans，participare 的现在分词
words.native_definition: a person who takes part in something
words.core_concept: the one holding a share of the work – 手里攥着一份活的那个人
words.core_image: 名单上每个名字后头都跟着一段分给他的活
examples: Each participant received a badge.
Twelve participants signed up.
semantic_expansions: 参与者/参加者：领了一份、身在其中的人
words.recall_hint: participate（领份加入）+ -ant → 领了一份的那个人

words.root_logic: parti（份）+ -cle（小）→ 份里最小的那一点
words.origin: 拉丁语 particula（小部分），pars 的指小形
words.native_definition: an extremely small piece of matter
words.core_concept: the smallest share a thing can be broken into – 一物能分到的最小那一份
words.core_image: 光柱里浮着数不清的细屑，一粒一粒看得见
examples: Dust particles hung in the light.
There is not a particle of truth in it.
semantic_expansions: 微粒/粒子：份里最小的那一点
极少量：小到只剩一点点的那个量
words.recall_hint: parti（份）+ -cle（小）→ 份里最小的那一点

words.root_logic: particul（小份）+ -ar（…的）→ 单指其中那一份的 → 特定的；引申为挑剔
words.origin: 拉丁语 particularis（属于部分的），来自 particula
words.native_definition: specific rather than general; hard to please
words.core_concept: singling out one share instead of the whole – 从整体里只指定那一份
words.core_image: 他从一摞里单挑出那一份，别的都不看
examples: This particular case is different.
He is particular about his coffee.
semantic_expansions: 特定的：从整体里只指定那一份
挑剔的：只肯要合意那一份
详情：逐份说清的那些条目
words.recall_hint: particul（小份）+ -ar → 只指定其中那一份

words.root_logic: a-（ad- 朝）+ part（份）→ 各归各份 → 分处两边
words.origin: 古法语 a part（各自一边），来自拉丁语 ad partem（朝各份）
words.native_definition: separated by a distance; into pieces
words.core_concept: each share standing off on its own – 各份各占一边，中间空着
words.core_image: 两只箱子摆在屋子两头，中间空出一大片
examples: They stood ten metres apart.
The old chair fell apart.
semantic_expansions: 分开/相隔：各份各占一边
除外：把那一份单撇出去不算
words.recall_hint: a-（朝）+ part（份）→ 各归各份、分处两边

words.root_logic: apart（各归各份）+ -ment → 整栋被隔出来的那一户
words.origin: 法语 appartement，来自意大利语 appartamento ← a parte（各自一边）
words.native_definition: a set of rooms in a building, used as one home
words.core_concept: the share a building is divided into – 整栋房子分出来的那一份
words.core_image: 一层楼被墙隔成几户，各有各的门
examples: They rent an apartment downtown.
Her apartment is on the third floor.
semantic_expansions: 公寓/套房：整栋房子隔出来的那一份
words.recall_hint: apart（各归各份）+ -ment → 隔出来的那一户

words.root_logic: dia-（穿过）+ meter（量度）→ 穿过圆心量出的那条长
words.origin: 希腊语 diametros（横贯的线），来自 dia（穿过）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: a straight line passing through the centre of a circle
words.core_concept: the length measured straight across through the middle – 从中间穿过去量出的那一段长
words.core_image: 一条线从圆边穿过正中，抵到对面那一点
examples: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres.
Measure the diameter of the pipe.
semantic_expansions: 直径：穿过圆心量出的那条长
words.recall_hint: dia-（穿过）+ meter（量度）→ 穿过正中量出的长

words.root_logic: para-（旁）+ meter（量度）→ 旁边立起的量尺 → 划定范围的那个量
words.origin: 希腊语 para（旁）＋metron（量度），经近代科学用语入英语
words.native_definition: a limit or boundary that defines the scope of something
words.core_concept: the rod set alongside to mark how far a thing may go – 旁边立一根尺，定住它能走多远
words.core_image: 旋钮定在几个刻度上，机器只在这几档之内动
examples: Set the parameters before running the test.
We must work within these parameters.
semantic_expansions: 参数/参量：旁边立起、用来定量的那个尺度
界限：这把尺划出的可行范围
words.recall_hint: para-（旁）+ meter（量度）→ 旁立一尺定住范围

words.root_logic: thermo-（热）+ meter（量度）→ 量热的那件器具
words.origin: 希腊语 thermos（热）＋metron（量度），17 世纪造词
words.native_definition: an instrument for measuring temperature
words.core_concept: the tool that puts a number on how hot a thing is – 把冷热读成数字的那件器具
words.core_image: 玻璃管里那道细红线随冷热上下爬
examples: The thermometer read thirty degrees.
Put the thermometer under your arm.
semantic_expansions: 温度计/体温计：把冷热量成数字的那件器具
words.recall_hint: thermo-（热）+ meter（量度）→ 量热的器具

words.root_logic: geo-（地）+ metr（量度）+ -y → 本是量地之术，后成研究形与空间的学问
words.origin: 希腊语 geōmetria（测地术），来自 gē（地）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes and space
words.core_concept: what began as measuring the ground and grew into the study of shape – 起于量地，后来专研形状与空间
words.core_image: 拿绳量地，边长与夹角一一记下
examples: She teaches geometry to first-years.
The geometry of the roof is complex.
semantic_expansions: 几何学：起于量地、后专研形状空间的学问
几何结构：某物在形状上的排布
words.recall_hint: geo-（地）+ metr（量度）→ 起于量地的形状之学

words.root_logic: centi-（百分之一）+ metre（米）→ 一米的百分之一
words.origin: 法语 centimètre，由拉丁 centum（百）＋希腊 metron（量度）合成
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre
words.core_concept: one of the hundred parts a metre is cut into – 一米均分成百份里的一份
words.core_image: 尺子上一米被均分成一百格，取其中一格
examples: The line is four centimetres long.
Cut two centimetres off the end.
semantic_expansions: 厘米/公分：一米均分成百份后的一份
words.recall_hint: centi-（百分之一）+ metre（米）→ 一米的百分之一

words.root_logic: tractare（反复拉扯、处置）→ 把事拉到手上处置 → 对待、医治
words.origin: 古法语 traitier，来自拉丁语 tractare（处理），trahere（拉）的反复体
words.native_definition: to behave toward someone in a certain way; to give medical care
words.core_concept: drawing a matter to hand and dealing with it – 把事拉到手边，一样样处置
words.core_image: 他把那件事拉到手边，一条一条过
examples: They treated her with respect.
The doctor treated his wound.
semantic_expansions: 对待：把事或人拉到手边如此处置
治疗：把病拉到手上处置
款待：以酒食待客这般处置
words.recall_hint: tractare（拉到手上处置）→ 对待、医治

words.root_logic: treat（处置、商议）+ -y → 商议处置之后立下的文书
words.origin: 古法语 traité，来自拉丁语 tractatus（处理、论述）← tractare
words.native_definition: a formal agreement between countries
words.core_concept: what two sides set down after drawing the matter out together – 两方把事拉到一处议定后写下的那纸
words.core_image: 两方被拉到一张桌前，谈定的每条都写进纸里
examples: The treaty was signed in Vienna.
Both sides honoured the treaty.
semantic_expansions: 条约/协定：两方议定后写下的那纸文书
words.recall_hint: treat（商议处置）+ -y → 议定后立下的文书

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ treat（拉）→ 把自己往回拉 → 撤退；名词亦指退居之所
words.origin: 古法语 retrait（退回），来自拉丁语 retrahere（拉回）← re＋trahere
words.native_definition: to move back from a position; a quiet place to withdraw to
words.core_concept: drawing oneself back from where one stood – 把自己从原处往回拉
words.core_image: 队伍把自己往后拉，一步步离开那道坡
examples: The army retreated at nightfall.
She spends August at a mountain retreat.
semantic_expansions: 撤退/后退：把自己往回拉离原处
静居处：退到那里图个清静的地方
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ treat（拉）→ 把自己往回拉

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -ature → 亲手画下、认作己出的那道记号
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 signatura（盖印），来自 signare（标记）← signum（记号）
words.native_definition: a person's name written by themselves; a distinctive mark
words.core_concept: the mark one draws to own a thing as one's own – 亲手画下、用以认领的那道记号
words.core_image: 他在末尾落下自己那道熟手的笔迹，认作己出
examples: Put your signature at the bottom.
The dish is the chef's signature.
semantic_expansions: 签名/签字：亲手画下用以认领的记号
标志性特征：一眼就认得出是谁的那个标记
words.recall_hint: sign（记号）+ -ature → 亲手画下认作己出的记号

words.root_logic: signi（记号）+ fic（做）+ -ance → 做下记号的缘由 → 意义、分量
words.origin: 拉丁语 significantia（含意），来自 significare（示意）← signum＋facere
words.native_definition: the meaning of something; its importance
words.core_concept: why the mark was made there in the first place – 当初为什么在那儿划下记号
words.core_image: 那道刻痕反复被人提起，才显出当初为何划它
examples: The date has special significance.
They stressed the significance of the find.
semantic_expansions: 意义：做下这记号的缘由
重要性：这缘由分量有多重
words.recall_hint: signi（记号）+ fic（做）→ 划下记号的缘由

words.root_logic: signi（记号）+ fic（做）+ -ant → 值得划记号的 → 重要、显著
words.origin: 拉丁语 significans，significare 的现在分词
words.native_definition: large or important enough to be noticed
words.core_concept: worth putting a mark against – 够得上被划一道记号的
words.core_image: 满页里只有那一处被划了记号，看的人都停在那儿
examples: There was a significant rise in costs.
It is a significant step forward.
semantic_expansions: 重要的/显著的：够得上被划一道记号的
有意义的：这记号背后有缘由可讲
words.recall_hint: signi（记号）+ fic（做）→ 值得划下记号的

words.root_logic: strictus（拉紧的）→ 绷到不留余地 → 严格
words.origin: 拉丁语 strictus（拉紧的），stringere（拉紧）的过去分词
words.native_definition: demanding exact obedience; allowing no exception
words.core_concept: drawn so tight that no slack is left – 绷到一丝松都不留
words.core_image: 绳子拉到最紧，连一点回弹的余地都没有
examples: The school has strict rules.
He is strict about deadlines.
semantic_expansions: 严格的/严厉的：绷到不留一丝余地
words.recall_hint: strictus（拉紧的）→ 绷到不留余地

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ strict（拉紧）→ 往回收紧 → 把范围缩小
words.origin: 拉丁语 restrictus，restringere（拉回束紧）的过去分词 ← re＋stringere
words.native_definition: to keep something within limits; to reduce what is allowed
words.core_concept: pulling the cord back so the circle grows smaller – 绳往回收，能动的圈越缩越小
words.core_image: 绳往回一收，能走动的那圈跟着小了一半
examples: They restricted access to the site.
Her diet restricts salt.
semantic_expansions: 限制/约束：往回收紧、把可动范围缩小
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ strict（拉紧）→ 往回收紧范围

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ strict（拉紧）→ 用界线圈紧的一块 → 辖区
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 districtus（管辖范围），来自 distringere ← dis＋stringere
words.native_definition: an area of a town or country, often an official division
words.core_concept: the patch a boundary has been drawn tight around – 被界线圈紧的那一块地面
words.core_image: 界线一圈拉起来，圈内归一处管
examples: She grew up in the old district.
The school district covers three towns.
semantic_expansions: 地区/行政区：被界线圈紧、归一处管的那块地面
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ strict（拉紧）→ 界线圈紧的一块
